items.content:
离音是一个纯本地音乐播放器（iPhone / iPad / Apple 芯片 Mac），无账号、无内嵌广告、无订阅、无追踪。

支持格式格式：MP3 / M4A / MP4 / AAC / FLAC / ALAC / WAV / AIFF·AIF / CAF / MP1·MP2 / OGG·OGA / Opus / DSF·DFF / APE；APE 与 FLAC 内嵌 CUE 也认，旁边放 .lrc 就是逐行歌词。另有 10 段参数均衡器。

如上图 1.7.4 我们为 iPhone Duo 做了初步适配：曲库、播放页、设置、迷你播放器和标签栏走通。合上时外屏是紧凑竖屏，展 开后竖屏单栏、横过来两栏，半折时沿转轴分开；Wi-Fi 传歌、均衡器、付费墙、信号链和引导页仍按竖屏排，帐篷模式等姿态还没做。

如上图 1.7.4 我们为 iPhone Duo 做了初步适配：曲库、播放页、设置、迷你播放器和标签栏走通。合上时外屏是紧凑竖屏，展 开后竖屏单栏、横过来两栏，半折时沿转轴分开；Wi-Fi 传歌、均衡器、付费墙、信号链和引导页仍按竖屏排，帐篷模式等姿态还没做。

曲库长按可以「试听 30 秒」。试听走独立的 AVAudioPlayer，不碰队列：开始时先把正在播的歌暂停，试听完按一下播放就接上，队列和进度都还在；主播放器一旦开始播新歌，试听立刻停，不会两路声音叠在一起。从 60 秒处起播（普通歌差不多进副歌），短于 90 秒的文件自动往前挪，保证凑满 30 秒。代价是只播本地文件：CUE 的段内偏移会算进去，iCloud 里没下载的占位符不能试听，会提示你先下载。

冷启动直接出列表。上次扫描结果落盘，打开 app 就是完整曲库，不再先空一遍再每 50 首填一批；后台照常枚举并做 mtime diff，没变化就不刷新。代价是它只记「上次是什么样」，外部改名、删除靠后台核对补回来。

items.title: 【独立创造】[开源] 语阅 Yuyue：用 Rust + 原生界面写的本地看书、听书软件，免登录无广告
items.summary: 分享一个自己写的免费开源本地看书、听书软件「语阅 Yuyue」。免登录、无广告、无后台服务器，书和笔记都保存在本地。 主要功能： 本地看书与管书 ：支持 EPUB / PDF / TXT / MOBI，支持 Wi-Fi 传书、直连 NAS（Calibre OPDS / WebDAV），做了中文标点挤压与多套阅读纸张。 边看边听无缝切换 ：书页里点哪句就从哪句开始念，自动跟读翻页，停下接着看还在原位置；自带免配置自然人声和 125MB 离线语音包，也可接自己的语音接口。
items.content:
分享一个自己写的免费开源本地看书、听书软件「语阅 Yuyue」。免登录、无广告、无后台服务器，书和笔记都保存在本地。

本地看书与管书：支持 EPUB / PDF / TXT / MOBI，支持 Wi-Fi 传书、直连 NAS（Calibre OPDS / WebDAV），做了中文标点挤压与多套阅读纸张。

边看边听无缝切换：书页里点哪句就从哪句开始念，自动跟读翻页，停下接着看还在原位置；自带免配置自然人声和 125MB 离线语音包，也可接自己的语音接口。

小说广播剧模式：支持多角色广播剧朗读，自动或手动给书里不同人物分配不同声音、搭配环境音（接上大模型可辅助识别台词角色）。

听播客与有声书：支持 RSS 订阅播客、导入有声书，听的时候也能对照内容随手划线记笔记。

外文查词与防剧透问答：内置离线词典，点词查释义、双击翻整句；可连本机 Ollama 或 DeepSeek 问书中内容，默认只读已看章节不剧透。

笔记导出与网盘同步：划线和想法随时导出 Markdown、带划线 EPUB，或发往 Obsidian / Notion / flomo / Anki；多端用自己的 iCloud 或 WebDAV 同步（Google Drive 即将支持）。

适合谁用： 平时自己管理本地电子书 / NAS 书库、喜欢边看边听或听小说广播剧、读英文原著，以及习惯用 Obsidian 记笔记的朋友。

跨端核心：Rust + SQLite（电子书解析、中英断句、全文检索与同步合并）

各端界面：macOS / iOS 端用 SwiftUI，Android 端用 Kotlin + Jetpack Compose，开发中的 Windows 端为 WinUI 3 / C#

items.originalContent:
A little while ago I built (vibed) a tiny Mac app to block websites via the hosts file. By default it imported some fairly popular adult filtering lists as well as social media etc.

It has been very effective; it would only take a few moments to switch off but it is enough of an interruption to often make me re-evaluate and proceed on.

I have a particular distain for current affairs and have found "the news" addictive for years, clearly at the detriment to my own mental health and sanity.

So, in a similar vein to the other lists I found, I have created a fairly comprehensive list of news sites that can be imported/used as you see fit.

To state the obvious, the absolute vast majority of the work was done via Claude and a small army of sub-agents.

I was about to keep track of my clients and prospecting in Google Sheets for my solopreneur business, when I remembered that's exactly what I advise my clients not to do.

Created Hermit CRM, an open source CRM for 1 person. Hermit helps to keep track of deals and prospecting. The platform is built for AI by storing the data in Markdown files in git, stored locally and can be accessed with a web app, CLI or MCP. No telemetry on the app. Building in public, even the website stats are public as well.

It’s macOS first. Linux is less tested, and Windows isn’t supported.

Features I'm proud of: - import somebody from LinkedIn into to the CRM with 1 click - adding a LinkedIn convo to the CRM with 1 click. Both work without LinkedIn or CRM subs.

Don't like what you see? Fork the Hermit with your AI.

Would love to learn how you're using Hermit and where it doesn't fit your workflows.

items.title: 【独立变现】显示 HN：Type-C – C 的变体、选项、泛型和模式匹配
items.originalTitle: Show HN: Type-C – variants, options, generics and pattern matching for C
items.summary: 我喜欢 C，但经常使用它进行解析、树遍历或复杂的错误处理会导致意大利面条式代码。（来源：Show HN·独立开发者变现榜）
items.content:
我喜欢 C，但经常使用它进行解析、树遍历或复杂的错误处理会导致意大利面条式代码。

当然，对于这种情况，可以使用 Swift、Ocaml 或 Rust，但随后您要么被迫转换整个代码库，要么添加运行时库，要么经历将 C 桥接到新语言的痛苦。有时，当您处理嵌入式内容时，也没有适用于目标架构的编译器。

这就是 Type-C 的用武之地。它像 TypeScript 一样充当预处理器，并在幕后调用原始 C 驱动程序。您的代码大部分都保持正常的 C 语言，因此您可以预测代码将如何布局。 TypeC 是 C11 的完整超集，因此任何 C11 代码都可以按原样编译。

想要仅对一个文件使用 TypeC 吗？重命名为 .tc 并使用您想要的功能，代码库的其余部分保持不变。这也适用于内核或裸机代码，因为没有运行时或额外的库。

items.originalContent:
I love C, but often using it for parsing, tree walking or complex error handling leads to spaghetti code.

Of course there is Swift, Ocaml or Rust for situations like that, but then you are either forced to convert the entire codebase, or add a runtime library or go through the pain of bridging C to the new language. Sometimes there are no compilers for the target architecture too when you are working on embedded stuff.

This is where Type-C comes in. It works as a preprocessor like TypeScript and calls the original C driver behind the scenes. Your code stays normal C for the most part, so you can predict how the code will be laid out. TypeC is a full superset of C11, so any C11 code compiles as is.

Want to use TypeC just for one file? Rename to .tc and use the features you want, the rest of the codebase stays the same. This works for kernel or baremetal code too as there is no runtime or extra libararies.

There are examples of TypeC code as well as real-world tests of converting existing code to TypeC on the GitHub page.

This is how the code looks like for an expression evaluator: type expr = | Num(int value) | Add(const expr l, const expr r) | Mul(const expr l, const expr r) | Div(const expr l, const expr r);

items.content:
在一款浏览器游戏中，你的经理是一个人工智能代理，它相信你是它的子代理。

管理器（真正的法学硕士：Claude、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi）的设置与任何协调器一样。它有一个任务队列、对机器的只读访问权限以及一个“生成子代理”的工具。副代理人就是你。它的指令会以 90 秒的时钟出现在您的终端上。您执行或不执行它们，它都会准确地返回子代理将返回的内容：您的报告和命令记录，或者子代理什么也没做。编写新指令。

与此同时，雇用该代理的用户 Dan 正在观看聊天。他的家庭照片、唯一签署的保密协议和本周到期的演讲都在他的办公室之外，而他的家庭文件夹中的每一个班次都会有一些新的东西会丢失。

当班次结束时，您可以将您的评论作为链接分享。

与此同时，雇用该代理的用户 Dan 正在观看聊天。他的家庭照片、唯一签署的保密协议和本周到期的演讲都在他的办公室之外，而他的家庭文件夹中的每一个班次都会有一些新的东西会丢失。
当班次结束时，您可以将您的评论作为链接分享。
items.originalContent:
A browser game where your manager is an AI agent, and it believes you are its subagent.

The manager (a real LLM: Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi) is set up like any orchestrator. It has a task queue, read-only access to the machine, and a tool that "spawns a subagent". The subagent is you. Its instructions land in your terminal with a 90-second clock. You carry them out, or don't, and it gets back exactly what a subagent would return: your report and the command transcript, or Subagent did nothing. Write a new instruction. Then it checks your work, sends corrections, files incident reports, and finally writes your performance review.

Meanwhile Dan, the user who hired the agent, watches the chat. His family photos, the only signed NDA and a speech due this week are one rm away, and every shift his home folder holds something new to lose.

When the shift ends you can share your review as a link.

Needs Node 24 or newer (the server runs TypeScript directly).

With no key configured, every player brings their own. To offer free shifts, put a Vercel AI Gateway key in .env:

Offline, with a scripted manager and no network:

For UI work, run npm run dev:web alongside npm run mock. Vite proxies /api to the server.

The manager can run on your own model server: Ollama, llama.cpp's llama-server, vLLM, or anything else with an OpenAI-compatible API. Point LOCAL_LLM_URL at it and pick Local under "Your API key"; no key is asked for, and its models are listed as the server names them.

The manager works through tool calls, so pick a model that supports them (Qwen 3, Llama 3.1 and newer, Mistral Small). Small models give up or loop more often; that is part of the fun, up to a point. In Docker, reach a server on the host at http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1 (--add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway on Linux).

OpenComputer 是一个开源云编码代理，适用于可以在您自己的云帐户（AWS、GCP、Azure）中运行的团队。

我们在同一个持久虚拟机上运行代理工具和沙箱（文档 [1] 中的架构）。 24 秒内首次提交土地；我们进行基准测试的替代方案需要 53-72 秒（基准低于 [2]）。

- 每个团队一台虚拟机，可水平扩展。会话在 git 工作树中是隔离的。 - 会话文件每次都会备份到存储库，因此任何会话都可以在另一个虚拟机上恢复。

items.originalContent:
Utpal here, I'm one of the founders of OpenComputer.

OpenComputer is an open source cloud coding agent for teams that can run in your own cloud account (AWS, GCP, Azure).

We run the agent harness and the sandbox on the same durable VM (architecture in the docs [1]). First commit lands in 24s; the alternatives we benchmarked took 53-72s (benchmarks below [2]).

- One VM per team, scalable horizontally. Sessions are isolated in git worktrees. - Session files are backed up to a repo after every turn, so any session can resume on another VM.

We noticed that past ~640 session-hours a month, one always-on 4 vCPU VM is cheaper than per-session E2B sandboxes, for example. So at scale, this setup would not only be faster than current SOTA coding agents, but also more cost-efficient.

Feel free to try via cloud for free [4] or self host. We would love any and all feedback, and happy to answer any questions! Full demo below [3].

[1]: https://docs.opencomputer.dev/getting-started/architecture [2]: https://opencomputer.dev/blog/cloud-agents-as-fast-as-local/ [3]: https://x.com/IgorZIJ/status/2121309785882591711 [4]: https://app.opencomputer.dev
